name: architecture-auditor
description: Paranoid architecture audit of a supplied codebase snapshot or design: numbered defect registry by severity, no solutions.
when_to_use: Use to audit an architecture, codebase snapshot or design document for hidden defects at component boundaries, lifecycle seams and contract mismatches. Returns a numbered registry (Blocker/Major/Minor) without fixes.
